command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp

echo "== ff14SB ships in the ambertools package (zero staging) =="
test -f /opt/conda/dat/leap/cmd/leaprc.protein.ff14SB

echo "== tleap builds a capped alanine, sander runs 20-step in-vacuo NVE =="
cat > l.in <<'EOF'
source leaprc.protein.ff14SB
sys = sequence { ACE ALA NME }
saveamberparm sys sys.parm7 sys.rst7
quit
EOF
tleap -f l.in > tleap.log 2>&1
cat > md.in <<'EOF'
minimal
 &cntrl
  imin=0, nstlim=20, dt=0.001, ntb=0, cut=99.0,
  ntpr=1, ntt=0, ntc=1
 /
EOF
sander -O -i md.in -p sys.parm7 -c sys.rst7 -o md.out -r md.rst > sander.log 2>&1

python3 - <<'PY' > smoke-check.txt || { cat smoke-check.txt; exit 1; }
import re, sys
fail=[]
def check(label, ok, detail):
    print(f"{label:24s} {detail}")
    if not ok: fail.append(label)

# tleap wrote the topology+coords -- exact shape
import os
for f in ("sys.parm7","sys.rst7"):
    check(f"tleap_wrote_{f.split('.')[1]}", os.path.getsize(f)>0, f"{os.path.getsize(f) if os.path.exists(f) else 0} B")
# ACE+ALA+NME capped alanine is 22 atoms in ff14SB -- read from rst7 line 2
natoms=int(open("sys.rst7").read().splitlines()[1].split()[0])
check("atoms_in_system", natoms==22, f"{natoms}  want exactly 22 (ACE-ALA-NME)")

text=open("md.out").read()
# per-step Etot only (drop the AVERAGES / RMS trailing summary blocks)
steps=text.split("A V E R A G E S")[0]
etot=[float(m.group(1)) for m in re.finditer(r"Etot\s+=\s*(-?\d+\.\d+)", steps)]
check("etot_steps", len(etot)>=2, f"{len(etot)} per-step Etot values  want >= 2")
# NVE conservation: no thermostat, so total energy must be conserved -- a physical law
drift=max(etot)-min(etot) if etot else 99
check("nve_conserved", drift<0.5, f"drift {drift:.4f} kcal/mol < 0.5 over 20 steps (NVE)")
check("etot_negative", etot and etot[0]<0, f"{etot[0] if etot else 'NA'}  want < 0")
# cross-check against sander's OWN independently-computed RMS fluctuation of Etot
rms=re.search(r"R M S.*?Etot\s+=\s*(-?\d+\.\d+)", text, re.S)
check("sander_own_rms", rms and float(rms.group(1))<0.5, f"{rms.group(1) if rms else 'NA'}  sander's own Etot RMS < 0.5")

if fail: print("FAILED: "+", ".join(fail)); sys.exit(1)
PY
cat smoke-check.txt
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
